pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using NaOH (sodium hydroxide), KOH (potassium hydroxide), or Ca(OH)2 (calcium hydroxide), conducted in pH ranges from 8 to 13, typically at 150°C for 20 minutes, or combined with hydrodynamic cavitation.
Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) pretreatment using a hydrocavitator system, involving fluid flow through an orifice plate to create microbubbles, followed by mixing with NaOH for combined pretreatment.
Thermal pretreatment using an oil bath to heat sludge samples at temperatures ranging from 110°C to 150°C for 20 minutes.
Ultrasonication pretreatment using a VCX-750 ultrasonic processor at 20 kHz frequency with 750 W maximum amplitude for 1, 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes.
